subject: HIPAA BAA eligibility & PHI handling - follow-up

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: security@medwisehealth.com
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / Redwood demo - follow-up on PHI question

Hi Ananya — great question and thank you for raising this in the call. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps: 

1) BAA availability: Redwood does offer a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for customers processing PHI. We can execute our standard BAA; I have attached the Redwood_BAA_template.pdf for your legal/security to kick off review. If you have customer-specific language, please flag it and we can route to our contracts team.

2) Eligible deployment modes for PHI: 
- Hosted API (shared, multi-tenant): NOT eligible for processing PHI.
- Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pools): Eligible with additional controls and a contractual BAA; recommended for production PHI workloads where you want managed, SLA-backed capacity.
- Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem): Eligible and recommended when you require customer-managed networking, KMS/HSM integration, or on-prem air-gapped deployments for regulated workflows.

3) SOC 2 & evidence: We are SOC 2 Type II. I’ve attached a redacted SOC2_report_redacted.pdf for your review. For full evidence exchange we typically work with your security team (security@medwisehealth.com) and coordinate a secure link/portal or an NDA, depending on scope.

4) Next steps I propose: 
- Alex/security: please confirm which deployment mode you prefer for the PHI scope (Dedicated vs. Private) and whether you need on-prem.
- If you want to proceed: we’ll initiate the BAA and send a vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) link for your team to complete.
- I’ll loop in our security lead (Rishi) and solutions engineer (Dev) to handle technical/ops questions and timeline.

Cc'd Rishi and Dev now. I’ll follow up with the VSQ link and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP).

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex / security <security@medwisehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dr. Ananya Smith <ananya.smith@medwisehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / Redwood demo - follow-up on PHI question

Hi Alex / Ananya — looping in the security/engineering folks to answer the technical pieces. Short answers up front: 

- KMS/key separation: For Redwood Dedicated we support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations in cloud-hosted Dedicated (AWS KMS, GCP KMS). For our Private on-prem deployments we can support local HSM/KMS integrations. We will note any provider-specific limitations during onboarding.

- BAA coverage for Dedicated: Yes — Dedicated and Private are explicitly eligible in our BAA. We can include an addendum if MedWise requires specific contract language; we typically handle this as a redline with our legal team and try to keep the BAA standard to speed time-to-signature.

- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II. The redacted report Marissa attached is the normal starting point. For scope questions we can schedule a short call with our compliance lead; we can also provide SOC 2 Bridge letters if needed for procurement cycles.

- VSQ / evidence exchange: I’ll create a secured intake for your VSQ and send a link by EOD. That intake will accept your questionnaire and any attachments; once we receive it we’ll route to the responsible owners and provide consolidated answers within 3-5 business days (depending on complexity).

- PHI boundary guidance: As Marissa noted, do NOT use the Hosted multi-tenant API for PHI. If you need to move from Dedicated to Private or vice-versa later, we can support migration plans but will need to validate KV cache, log retention, and telemetry controls as part of the migration.

Proposed next steps (action items):
1) MedWise: confirm whether you want Dedicated (cloud-hosted with customer KMS) for pilot or Private (VPC/on-prem).
2) MedWise: complete high-level scoping form I will attach/send (data types, volumes, retention requirements).
3) Redwood: I will send a secured VSQ intake link and our standard BAA for review (we'll set up a DocuSign envelope for signatures).
4) Tech sync: schedule a 30-minute call with Dev (solutions engineer) and Ethan (onboarding lead) to discuss network/firewall/KMS details.

I’m attaching the BAA template and redacted SOC 2 here again for convenience and will open the VSQ link shortly: https://redwood.app/security-portal/MW-0873

Thanks — happy to hop on a call this week if helpful.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai
